 Morocco’s General Directorate of Taxes (DGI) reminded taxpayers in Rabat on November 10, 2026, that anyone liable for income tax on gains from a property sale must file a return and pay the tax due within 30 days of the transfer. Both steps can be completed online through the individual taxpayer section of the «SIMPL-IR Particuliers» portal.
 The return must include documents supporting acquisition costs and investment expenses, the DGI said.
 In cases of expropriation for public use, unlawful seizure, or a transfer of ownership ordered by a final court ruling, the 30-day period begins when the compensation or other sum awarded is received.
 A practical guide can be downloaded from the «SIMPL-IR Particuliers» section of the DGI website.
